[[File:Marka_ragnos_guantlets.jpg|thumb|Marka Ragnos' gauntlets]]
These ancient '''gloves''' were once owned by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Marka Ragnos]]. [[3956 BBY|A thousand and forty-four years after Ragnos' death]], they may have been found by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] inside the [[Tomb of Marka Ragnos]]. The black scales used to make the gauntlets still pulsed with dark power.

==Behind the scenes==
The gloves could only be used by [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] due to the strong [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] aura that surrounded them.
